newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran opens $600 million special steel plant.
newsitem.headline: Iran opens $600 million special steel plant.

text.p: Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani on Tuesday opened a $600 million special steel plant in central Iran, state-run Tehran radio said.

It said the plant, built in Yazd province for $500 million in hard currency and 300 billion rials ($100 million), would produce 200,000 tonnes of alloy steel products a year when completed. It did not say when the project would be finished.
Western media reports earlier said the plant was being built by Italy's Danieli & Co under a 1992 contract.
Iran has said its steel production reached six million tonnes in the year to March 20, up from 4.3 million tonnes the previous year.
($1=3,000 rials at the official exchange rate)
